newsitem.title: NORWAY: Russian defence minister to attend NATO meeting.
newsitem.headline: Russian defence minister to attend NATO meeting.

text.p: Russian Defence Minister General Igor Rodionov has accepted an invitation to attend an informal meeting of NATO defence ministers in Bergen on September 25-26, the Norwegian defence ministry said on Monday.
A spokeswoman said Rodionov had been invited to the meeting by NATO Secretary-General Javier Solana.
"We have received signals that he (Rodionov) will come to Bergen," she said.
In Madrid, Solana announced earlier on Monday he would meet Rodionov and other Russian leaders this month to work on a charter that will govern future relations.
